frozen_protocol.gradient_reference: mean of per-image unit-normalized concatenated selected-parameter gradients; same-class real memberships from immutable internal_train annotations; real self-comparison uses leave-one-out
frozen_protocol.feature_roi: each target box mapped from normalized xywh to feature grid; spatial average per box, then average boxes of same class per image
frozen_protocol.mechanism_decision: descriptive A-E gates plus annotation-count confound check; a signal may be promoted only if exactly one candidate meets all A-E and source/target annotation-count distributions match. No causal claim. Otherwise NOT_IDENTIFIED
frozen_protocol.mechanism_gate_A: loss/norm synthetic median outside real Q25-Q75 in each bank and class; sign-conflict fraction has nonoverlapping Wilson 95% intervals versus real in each bank and class
frozen_protocol.mechanism_gate_B: all three bank differences have same nonzero sign in each class
frozen_protocol.mechanism_gate_C: Flash and Black signs do not oppose
frozen_protocol.mechanism_gate_D: median matched-triplet within-slot range is nonzero in both classes
frozen_protocol.mechanism_confound_guard: per-class empirical annotation-instance-count proportions must match between real and each synthetic bank; if not, loss/gradient contrasts are not unconfounded
frozen_protocol.bank_order_usage: descriptive ordering check only; not for metric, layer, threshold, or sample selection; no bank correlation
